cases.generated_sql: WITH parent_mol AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1422'), relevant_mols AS (SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy mh JOIN parent_mol pm ON mh.parent_molregno = pm.molregno UNION SELECT pm.molregno FROM parent_mol pm) SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, s.description AS assay_description, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM relevant_mols rm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON rm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN activities a ON rm.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON s.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'

cases.uq: Retrieve the first 200 rows from the metabolism table with canonical SMILES, substrate record ID, metabolite record ID, substrate compound key, metabolite compound key, metabolic conversion, and pathway key. Use substrate_record_id as a mandatory join to the substrate compound_records row and then to compound_structures for canonical_smiles, so canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key come from the substrate side and must not be null because of an optional join. Use metabolite_record_id to join the metabolite compound_records row for metabolite_compound_key; that metabolite-side join may be optional if the metabolite record is absent. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, and pathway_key.
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cs_sub.canonical_smiles, m.substrate_record_id, m.metabolite_record_id, cr_sub.compound_key AS substrate_compound_key, cr_met.compound_key AS metabolite_compound_key, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key FROM metabolism m INNER JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_met ON m.metabolite_record_id = cr_met.record_id LIMIT 200

cases.uq: Retrieve approved drugs from ChEMBL together with preferred name, canonical SMILES, max clinical phase, indication heading, and first approval year. Keep only approved drugs with max_phase = 4 and return exactly chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mesh_heading, and first_approval, ordered by most recent first approval. Return DISTINCT rows only for those requested output columns.
cases.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, md.max_phase, di.mesh_heading, md.first_approval FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 ORDER BY md.first_approval DESC
